reason_for_shift: The first cross-venue screen combined predictive, lag, spread, and full-depth requirements in one cheap gate. This left at most 2 older and 6 recent observations, so it tested a sparse execution intersection rather than the underlying directional thesis.
principles: Do not lower or add thresholds to a scored family.
Measure predictive validity before paying the cost of execution simulation.
Keep labels physically absent from source coverage and feature-distribution stages.
Use fresh fully resolved windows only after fixed discovery and exact-execution gates pass.
Keep every family budget terminal: one preregistration, one discovery score, at most two exact traces.

stages.name: source_and_causality
stages.inputs: sealed coordinates plus outcome-free source adapters
stages.advance_when: coverage and causal timestamp contracts are complete

stages.name: raw_predictive_screen
stages.inputs: fixed source-only directional rules and discovery-only labels
stages.advance_when: the same fixed rule has adequate support and positive directional edge in both chronological partitions

stages.name: marketability_screen
stages.inputs: stage-1 trace joined to causal quotes
stages.labels_allowed: same discovery labels, no new search
stages.advance_when: positive fee-aware proxy economics without changing the stage-1 rule

stages.name: exact_execution_replay
stages.advance_when: Wilson edge is at least +0.02 and PnL is positive

stages.name: fresh_resolved_holdout
stages.labels_allowed: fresh only after stage 3 opens the gate
stages.advance_when: fixed fresh gate passes; otherwise terminal rejection

next_family_contract.required_change: implement a manifest-driven generic runner with separate raw_predictive and marketability outputs
forbidden: reuse its observed outcomes to choose thresholds
add hours or exact traces to any terminal family
use VPS paper mode for a backtestable question
